Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.description: Public repository of scheduled power outage data in Ukraine.
Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

Public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and generating PNG images of scheduled and emergency power outage schedules in Ukraine.

The project fetches data from public web pages of providers and stores it as JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. This data is then rendered in a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved to `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abridged):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "м. Київ",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored "as is", without normalizing the structure.
- `fact` — actual/emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

KaffuAlcaid/CNKIBug.body:
# CNKIBug

CNKIBug helps you batch-find literature on research topics on China National Knowledge Infrastructure (CNKI). It combines results from multiple keyword groups or search criteria, filters them, and exports them as a spreadsheet or imports them into Zotero.

**[Download Windows version](https://github.com/KaffuAlcaid/CNKIBug/releases/latest/download/CNKIBug-GUI.exe)** · [Download Linux version](https://github.com/KaffuAlcaid/CNKIBug/releases/latest/download/CNKIBug-GUI-x86_64.AppImage) · [Usage guide](https://github.com/KaffuAlcaid/CNKIBug/blob/HEAD/docs/usage.md)

Quick navigation: [Main features](#主要功能) · [Getting started](#开始使用) · [Interface and export](#界面与导出) · [Documentation and feedback](#文档与反馈) · [License and acknowledgments](#许可与致谢)

## Main features

- **Batch literature search**: Enter multiple keyword groups or import a TXT list, or combine advanced search criteria; set the search scope, sort order, and language
- **Save profiles and resume tasks**: Save commonly used search criteria; if a task is interrupted, you can resume from the most recently completed page
- **View and filter results**: Combine results from multiple searches, merge duplicate literature, filter by title, author, search field, or literature type, and view abstracts, keywords, and citations
- **Export literature**: Save selected literature as Excel, CSV, or RIS, or send literature entries and their linked PDFs to Zotero
- **Download and link PDFs**: Add full texts you have access to into a download queue, manage pausing, resuming, and retrying failures, and verify files after an interruption; you can also link existing local PDFs

Advanced search, PDF download, direct sending to Zotero, and journal information lookup are experimental features. Downloading full texts requires the appropriate institutional or individual access rights.

## Getting started

Windows 10/11 users can run the downloaded `CNKIBug-GUI.exe` directly. The computer needs Microsoft Edge installed.

1. **Prepare a search task**: Enter keywords, set the number of pages for each item and the save location, click "Check and start search", confirm the task details, then start
2. **Run the search**: If CNKI requires security verification, complete it manually in the browser that opens, then continue as the program prompts
3. **Filter and export**: Open "Paper results", check the literature you want to keep, choose an export format, and click "Export selected"

Exported files are saved to the directory set in the main window's settings.

Linux provides an experimental x86-64 AppImage, and the program can also be run from source. For installation steps and detailed instructions, see the [usage guide](https://github.com/KaffuAlcaid/CNKIBug/blob/HEAD/docs/usage.md).

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

XueTianyu24/ClaudeDeck.body:
# Beacon

> A local console for Claude Code. It is a desktop app that combines **session monitoring, completion notifications, memory visualization, skill management, multi-channel mobile push, a launcher, and usage billing**, and it supports **one-click in-app auto-update** (with signature verification).

It turns the state scattered across `~/.claude/` into a visual "cockpit". All data comes from the local `~/.claude/` directory, so no reverse engineering or hacks are needed.

> **About the name**: The app's display name is **Beacon** (lighthouse), but the GitHub repository, the download filename (`ClaudeDeck.exe`), and the app identifier still use **ClaudeDeck**, so that the auto-update pipeline for existing users is not interrupted. Both names refer to the same app.

## Features

- 📡 **Session monitoring** ✅: Shows in real time which Claude Code sessions are running, idle, waiting for input, or suspected of being stuck, along with the project each one runs in and how long it has been running.
- 🔔 **Completion notifications** ✅: When a long task finishes or authorization is needed, a **desktop popup and sound** alert you (the threshold is configurable and short Q&A is filtered out).
- 📱 **Mobile push** ✅: Install the Claude Code hook with one click inside the app, and push "task complete / awaiting authorization" to your phone via **Bark / iPhone** or **PushPlus / WeChat**. **You receive these even when the app is not open.**
- 🧠 **Memory visualization** ✅: A unified panel to view and edit global and project-level memory. auto-memory is automatically sorted into cards by frontmatter, `[[name]]` renders as a **force-directed relationship graph**, and Markdown renders the global `CLAUDE.md` and project `MEMORY.md`. It supports **edit write-back, delete (with a recycle bin and restore), and empty directory cleanup**.
- 🧩 **Skill management** ✅: Visually browse `~/.claude/skills/`. View SKILL.md in cards, expand a **file structure tree** (including references), use **tag management, filtering, and search**, and open a skill directory in Explorer with one click.
- 💰 **Usage billing** ✅: Counts each session's token consumption and its **equivalent API cost** (sorted from highest to lowest cost, with totals and a breakdown by model), plus **daily / weekly / monthly overviews**. Rates are built in and work offline. Cache writes are priced separately at 1h (2×) and 5m (1.25×), which is closer to real billing.
- 🚀 **Claude launcher** ✅: Records recently used working directories. Double-click one to start a new session there. Optionally, inject environment variables such as a proxy before launch.
- ⏰ **Scheduled window opening** ✅: Automatically opens Claude's 5-hour usage window at times you set according to your schedule. The window starts at the first message: at the scheduled time it runs `claude -p` and sends a minimal message to open the window. lubin776/tvbox-api-backup.description: TVBox API automated backup project, including interface scraping, live stream source aggregation, and static front-end navigation, built on Python + GitHub Actions, with all configuration kept external.
lubin776/tvbox-api-backup.body:
# Mass Interface Relay and Backup Site

A TVBox interface relay and backup project built on GitHub Actions automation and static hosting. Three script sets run on a daily schedule to fetch, parse, and aggregate various TVBox interfaces and live stream sources. Outputs are automatically committed back to the repository, and the front-end page reads and displays them in real time. It supports one-click copy, search, and multi-domain backup.

---

## Table of Contents

- [Project Overview](#项目简介)
- [Online Access](#在线访问)
- [Repository Structure](#仓库结构)
- [Automated Workflows](#自动化工作流)
- [Detailed Explanation of the Three Scripts](#三个脚本详解)
- [Front-End Page](#前端页面)
- [Configuration File Description](#配置文件说明)
- [Running Locally](#本地手动运行)
- [Deploying to Cloudflare Pages](#部署到-cloudflare-pages)
- [Common Issues and Pitfalls](#常见问题与避坑)
- [Configuration Change Quick Reference](#配置修改速查)
- [One-Click Verification Checklist](#一键校验清单)
- [Disclaimer](#声明)

---

## Project Overview

This project batch-relays, backs up, and aggregates publicly available TVBox interface resources from the internet. GitHub Actions fetches them on a schedule and commits them to the repository, and a statically hosted front-end page then serves them, providing:

- **Interface backup**: 90+ on-demand (VOD) interfaces, each providing 1 to 5 mirror lines with automatic line selection.
- **Live aggregation**: extracts live sources from the `lives` field of all VOD interfaces, unwraps wrapper layers, and generates a playlist.
- **Collection site aggregation**: extracts collection sites with `type` 0/1 from the `sites` of all interfaces and generates a standalone aggregated interface.
- **Py site aggregation**: extracts Py site interfaces ending in `.py`, fills in missing fields, and generates an aggregated interface.
- **Download resources**: batch-fetches local package and download resources into the `ry/` directory.
- **Multi-domain backup**: the front end offers three mutually backing access domains; any one of them can be used.
- **Static hosting**: a pure front-end page with no backend, simple deployment, and fast access.

---

luckyf1oat/vpngate-sstp-checker.body:
# vpngate-sstp-checker

Two jobs, both running in GitHub Actions:

| Workflow | Frequency | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| **collect.yml** | Hourly at :05 | Pulls the official API and list page, merges the currently visible SSTP servers into the `sstpall.txt` library (deduplicated, cumulative) |
| **check.yml** | Every 2 hours at :30 | Calls `https://cks5.115567.xyz/check?sstp=vpn:vpn@host:port` to test "last valid + full library"; **about 42 seconds for 200 servers** |
| check-local.yml | Manual | Local-connection version using pppd/sstpc (backup, for when cks5 is down) |

## Outputs

**`sstpall.txt`**: cumulative library, one per line:

```
sstp://vpn:vpn@public-vpn-114.opengw.net:443
sstp://vpn:vpn@vpn849985359.opengw.net:1773
```

**`result.txt`**: nodes verified usable in this run (link + exit IP details):

```
sstp://vpn:vpn@public-vpn-114.opengw.net:443  {"ip":"219.100.37.236","country":"JP","countryName":"Japan","region":"Tokyo","city":"Tokyo","asn":"AS36599","org":"SoftEther Corporation","timezone":"Asia/Tokyo","colo":"NRT"}
```

`result.json` includes connection time `connect_s`; `sstpall.json` includes, for each server, `first_seen / last_seen / last_checked / last_ok / ok_count / fail_count`.

## Ranking `result-ranked.txt`

The same nodes, sorted by composite score from high to low. The trailing JSON on each line has two extra fields: `score` (0–100) and `score_parts` (per-dimension scores).

|---|---|---|
| Residential IP | 30 | Exit org/ASN matches ISP keywords = residential (30); neutral (16.5); matches datacenter/cloud/VPN vendor (4.5) |
| Bandwidth | 20 | `log10(speed_mbps)/log10(800)`, capped; 800 Mbps gets full marks (self-reported by vpngate) |

ntbowen/git-monitor.description: Automatically monitors specified Git repositories for changes (commits, tags, releases) and sends notifications via Telegram and WeChat (WxPusher).
ntbowen/git-monitor.body:
# Git Repository Monitor 📡

Automatically monitors specified Git repositories for changes (commits, tags, releases) and sends notifications via Telegram and WeChat (WxPusher).

## Features

- ✅ Monitor new commits
- ✅ Monitor new tags
- ✅ Monitor new releases
- ✅ Telegram Bot notifications
- ✅ WeChat notifications (via WxPusher)
- ✅ Automatic scheduled checks
- ✅ Persistent state to avoid duplicate notifications

## Quick Start

### 1. Fork or clone this repository

```bash
git clone <your-repo-url>
cd <your-repo-name>
```

### 2. Configure GitHub Variables and Secrets

Go to the repository's **Settings → Secrets and variables → Actions**

#### 📋 Variables (non-sensitive information) - Recommended

On the **Variables** tab, add:

| Variable Name | Description | Example |
|------------|------|------|
| `MONITORED_REPOS` | List of repositories to monitor (separate multiple repositories with commas) | `torvalds/linux,microsoft/vscode` |
| `MONITORED_REPO` | Monitor a single repository (backward compatibility) | `torvalds/linux` |
| `MONITOR_COMMITS` | Whether to monitor commits (optional) | `true` / `false` |
| `MONITOR_TAGS` | Whether to monitor tags (optional) | `true` / `false` |
| `MONITOR_RELEASES` | Whether to monitor releases (optional) | `true` / `false` |

**Advantages:**
- ✅ Can be viewed and edited directly, no need to re-enter
- ✅ Non-sensitive information does not need encryption
- ✅ Easier to manage

**Notes:**
- `MONITORED_REPOS` is preferred for monitoring multiple repositories
- Separate multiple repositories with English commas, e.g.: `owner1/repo1,owner2/repo2,owner3/repo3`
- Monitoring options are all enabled by default (`true`); set to `false` to disable
- Flexible combinations are supported, e.g.: monitor only tags and releases, not commits

**Monitoring configuration example:**
```
# Monitor only releases
MONITOR_COMMITS=false
MONITOR_TAGS=false
MONITOR_RELEASES=true

# Monitor only tags and releases…
```

# DouAi

## 0.2.48 Official release: AI video cover recovery

**0.2.48 / 149** Fixes the cover candidate fallback and retry for manual AI chat video cards. It keeps multiple safe candidates, queues re-sends, automatically retries once, and allows manual retry if it still fails. Stopping the current reply does not cancel the cover of old messages.

This release cumulatively includes the comment AI search and parsing, work media context, follow-up question, and related video pagination improvements from 0.2.42–0.2.47. The APK is signed with the long-term release key. Local targeted tests passed; full tests and a standalone Release Lint were not run; the build's built-in vital Lint passed. User feedback reports that manual testing passed, but devices and coverage were not recorded. GitHub and LSPosed use the same APK, and each channel attaches only the APK. [Release notes](https://github.com/yudigaga/DouAi/blob/HEAD/docs/release-0.2.48.md).

## 0.2.41 Official release: Douyin 41.0.0 gesture and profile fixes

**0.2.41 / 142** Adds support for Douyin **41.0.0 / 410001 / internal build 41009900**, and fixes gesture and auto-play registration failures, local statistics neighbor filtering, and profile numeric fields. The 40.6.0 and 40.8.0 adaptations are retained. Strict local validation: **2,973 items** with zero failures, zero errors, and zero skips. Release Lint: 0 errors, 54 existing warnings, 0 new. The original certificate v3 and 16 KiB alignment passed. Real devices, actual LSPosed, and real services were not verified. [Release notes](https://github.com/yudigaga/DouAi/blob/HEAD/docs/release-0.2.41.md). GitHub and LSPosed each attach only the same APK.

## 0.2.40 Local official release: Douyin 41.0.0 adaptation

**0.2.40 / 141** Adds a standalone adaptation for Douyin 41.0.0 / 410001 / internal build 41009900, and retains 40.6.0 and 40.8.0. The long-term certificate v3 and 16 KiB alignment passed. The final signed APK passed the full regression with **2,965 items, zero failures, zero errors, and zero skips**. Release Lint: 0 errors, 54 existing warnings, 0 new. Built locally only; real devices and real services were not verified. See the [build record](https://github.com/yudigaga/DouAi/blob/HEAD/docs/release-0.2.40.md).

## 0.2.39 Official release: Random voice and source management

**0.2.39 / 140** Adds random voice, off by default. Small random selects from the current source; large random selects from the checked available sources; each generation draws again. Large random allows multiple source selection, managing and refreshing the voice lists of the selected sources, and displays candidate counts and exclusion reasons. The selection applies only to this request and does not change manual configuration or the existing retry and text fallback rules.
